profile.org_note: Since 30 July 2026 a wholly owned subsidiary of Stanley Martin Homes (Reston, VA; Daiwa House Group), still run from Melbourne, FL by President and CEO Bruce Assam with Rich Brown over homebuilding operations. Towns are grouped into six Florida regions, each with a local office and director (regional offices: Cape Coral, Port St. Lucie, Winter Haven, Lecanto, Pensacola). Land sits with a corporate land team (Tony Palumbo, VP of Land, last named Dec 2024; Jim Hill, Land Development Manager) plus division managers who also source land; finance was led by CFO Richard Fadil, who has dropped off the leadership page since the sale. Capital and large land decisions now likely involve Stanley Martin and Daiwa House, but no post-deal reporting lines are published.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @holidaybuilders.com (one published example: tlohela@holidaybuilders.com)
profile.summary: Conventional for-sale, entry-level single-family builder across Florida (about 1,050 closings and $375M revenue in 2025, down from 1,672 closings in 2024), building on scattered lots, developer-bought lots and a growing number of self-developed communities; about 10,600 controlled lots and 40+ communities at the time of sale. Employee-owned (ESOP) from 1999 until Stanley Martin Homes, a Daiwa House Group company, bought 100% of it; the deal was announced 16 July 2026 and closed 30 July 2026. It is now a Stanley Martin subsidiary, so a land banker's real counterparty for capital decisions is probably Stanley Martin / Daiwa House, with Holiday's Melbourne team still sourcing the Florida land.
